heading: Chap. viii.—Exhortations to the presbyters and others.
paragraphs:
Ye presbyters, “feed the flock which is among you,”[1883] till
God shall show who is to hold the rule over you. For “I
am now ready to be offered,”[1884] that I “may win Christ.”[1885]
Let the deacons know of what dignity they are, and let them
study to be blameless, that they may be the followers of
Christ. Let the people be subject to the presbyters and the
deacons. Let the virgins know to whom they have consecrated
themselves.
